session_date.name: session_date
session_date.title: Session date

dataLocations.description: Fiorilli et al., tetrode recordings during a visual, tactile and visuotactile discrimination task in the rat. The bucket holds one folder, hbp-data-002061, with the data descriptor, the licence, code/ and data/. All session files sit flat in data/. The data descriptor says: 'The .pkl session files contain spike data and meta information, stored in python NEO objects. The *_lfps.nio files contain the LFP signals (readable using the Nixio library).' LFP traces are downsampled to 1000 Hz and spikes are sorted, so the location is processed data. Every entry of the bucket was listed.

filePatterns.name: spikes
filePatterns.description: Spike data and meta information as pickled Neo objects

filePatterns.name: lfp
filePatterns.description: LFP signals, 1000 Hz, NIX file. Present for 18 of the 25 sessions.

filePatterns.name: lfp_clean
filePatterns.description: Present for rat-16_181013 only, which has no _lfps.nio file. The data descriptor does not mention the _clean suffix.
